summary: Fix URT campaign import dedup identity and stale preview re-verification

delivery.outcome: Prevent URT campaign dedup-key collisions for colon-containing identifier pairs and enforce commit-time re-verification against live persisted state while staying compatible with pre-change state and receipts.
nonGoals: Modify unrelated sync adapters or Planfile ticket-storage schemas outside planfile/sync/urt_campaign_import.py.

architecture.decision: Keep colon-free dedup keys in campaign_id:proposal_id form while encoding colon-containing pairs via injective urt-key/v2 JSON list serialization; match pre-change persisted legacy keys via verified embedded urt_campaign identity and validate noop_duplicate, create, and supersede_revision against current state before persisting state or receipts.

components.name: URT campaign import deduplication and commit validation

interfaceChanges: Export build_urt_dedup_key helper for injective campaign_id/proposal_id dedup keys.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching planfile/sync/urt_campaign_import.py and tests/test_urt_campaign_import.py.

validation.evidence: Distinct identifier pairs with colons produce disjoint dedup keys and never collide.
Stale noop_duplicate and supersede_revision previews fail closed against newer state without emitting receipts; pre-change state and plain receipts remain compatible.
